faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Things you might be wondering about the mobile app development process.

delivery.question: How long does it take for the app to be ready?
delivery.answer: An MVP with core features usually becomes testable within 6-10 weeks. For comprehensive projects, this timeframe is determined by the features.

pricing.question: How are mobile app costs determined?
pricing.answer: We prepare a custom and transparent quote based on the feature set included in the app, backend complexity, and integration needs.

revisions.question: Can we add new ideas during the development phase?
revisions.answer: Because we work Agile, we can incorporate your feedback into the process in sprints. Major changes affecting the core architecture are re-planned together.

maintenance.question: Who ensures the app stays up-to-date after launch?
maintenance.answer: We test your app against new Apple and Google OS updates and guarantee it runs smoothly through our maintenance packages.

migration.question: Do you just convert my website into a mobile app (WebView)?
migration.answer: Instead of simple and low-performance WebView solutions, we develop real (Native/Cross-Platform) apps that utilize device hardware to its full capacity.

mobile.question: My website is already mobile-friendly; why do I need a separate app?
mobile.answer: Apps create brand loyalty by living on the phone's home screen. Moreover, they push your conversion rates far beyond the web with push notifications and a faster interface.
